newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Heaven dips on cautionary, but trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Heaven dips on cautionary, but trade thin.

text.p: Shares in South African confectioner Sweets From Heaven Holdings Ltd dipped on Tuesday after the firm issued a cautionary statement, dealers said.
The shares fell sharply by 14 cents to 222 cents, but dealers pointed out that volumes were thin with only 18,800 shares changing hands.
"It is down after the cautionary, but the trade has been very slight. Sentiment on the stock is basically positive, so this might be a bit of profit-taking," one dealer said.
Heaven said negotiations were currently taking place which, if successful, could affect its share price.
Shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their share dealings until a further announcement was made.
In May Heaven posted its first year results since listing and came in with a profit of 10.08 cents earnings per share, up from 6.83 cents last time.
